purity_gate.title: Purity Affirmation
purity_gate.question: Have you bathed and purified yourself?
purity_gate.subtitle: Bodily and mental purity is essential before entering the sacred sanctum.
purity_gate.snan_mantra_text: Gange cha Yamune chaiva Godavari Saraswati | Narmade Sindhu Kaveri jalesmin sannidhim kuru ||

cleaning.title: Temple Purification & Cleaning
cleaning.status_dusty: Dust has settled on the altar and yesterday's flowers have withered into nirmalya.
cleaning.step_flowers: 1. Collect withered flowers into the sacred Nirmalya Patra
cleaning.step_wipe: 2. Wipe the temple altar clean with a damp cloth
cleaning.step_diya: 3. Rinse and clean the brass diya
cleaning.clean_complete: The temple is now pristine and sacred. You may begin pooja.

step_1.name: Gather Items
step_1.instruction: Gather Gangajal, fresh blossoms, chandan, and offerings onto the brass thali.

step_2.name: Light Diya & Incense
step_2.instruction: Touch the flame to the diya wick and kindle the fragrant incense sticks.
step_2.mantra: Shubham Karoti Kalyanam Aarogyam Dhanasampada | Shatrubuddhivinashaya Deepajyotir Namostu Te ||

step_3.name: Bathing Deities (Abhishek)
step_3.instruction: Pour holy water gently over Shri Ganesh and Maa Lakshmi, then pat dry with silken cloth.
step_3.mantra: Om Apavitrah Pavitro Va Sarvavastham Gato'pi Va | Yah Smaret Pundarikaksham Sa Bahyabhyantarah Shuchih ||

step_4.name: Tilak & Flower Offering
step_4.instruction: Apply sacred Chandan and Kumkum on deities' foreheads and offer fresh blossoms.
step_4.mantra: Om Shri Ganeshaya Namah | Om Mahalaksmyai Namah

step_5.name: Bell Ringing & Aarti
step_5.instruction: Ring the brass bell while rotating the illuminated Aarti Thali in clockwise circles.
step_5.mantra: Karpura Gauram Karunavataram Sansarasaram Bhujagendraharam | Sada Vasantam Hridayaravinde Bhavam Bhavani Sahitam Namami ||

step_6.name: Blowing the Shankh
step_6.instruction: Press and hold the conch to purify the environment with primordial resonance.
step_6.mantra: Tvam Pura Sagarotpanno Vishnuna Vidhritah Kare | Nirmitah Sarvadevaishcha Panchajanya Namostu Te ||

step_7.name: Offering Prasad (Bhog)
step_7.instruction: Offer Modak and Kheer, and perform three circular waves of Achaman water.
step_7.mantra: Om Pranaya Swaha | Om Apanaya Swaha | Om Vyanaya Swaha | Om Udanaya Swaha | Om Samanaya Swaha ||

step_8.name: Singing Aarti
step_8.instruction: Listen, sing along, and immerse in divine surrender with the sacred Aarti.
step_8.mantra: Aarti Shri Ganesh Ji & Maa Lakshmi Ji

deities.ganesh_desc: Remover of Obstacles, First Worshipped, Bestower of Intellect
deities.lakshmi_desc: Goddess of Wealth, Prosperity, and Divine Grace

completion.title: Pooja Completed!
completion.blessing: May Lord Ganesha and Mother Lakshmi bless your home with peace, happiness, and prosperity.
